dispatches.text: March, AD 68. Word comes from Gaul: Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, has risen against Nero.
XI Claudia takes your promises.
Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, raises the Gauls against Nero.
Dalmatia is yours.
At Hispania Tarraconensis, the old governor Servius Sulpicius Galba lets his men hail him: legate of the Senate and People, he says, not yet emperor.
Titus Arrius Priscus, legate of V Macedonica, claims the purple in Judaea.
Publius Annius Crispus swears to you when your province falls: a legate of one of your legions. He can command an army or govern a province for you.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and you.
Nero's exiles come home and get their estates back. Their families remember who did it.
In Africa, Clodius Macer, legate of III Augusta, holds back the grain ships and raises a legion of his own.
A truce is agreed between Titus Arrius Priscus and Lucius Clodius Macer.
Nero is dead. Abandoned by the Praetorians, he took his own life outside Rome. The Senate rules, for now.
Quintus Numisius Marcellus, legate of XXII Deiotariana, claims the purple in Aegyptus.
Titus Arrius Priscus has lost his last legion. His cause is finished.
Your legions hail you as imperator.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Lucius Clodius Macer.
The Senate names you legate of the Senate and People of Rome.
The Senate declares Lucius Clodius Macer a public enemy of the Roman people.
Gnaeus Annius Gallus, legate of V Alaudae, claims the purple in Germania Inferior.
The Senate declares Gnaeus Annius Gallus a public enemy of the Roman people.
The Mauretanian chiefs send 3000 men to Servius Sulpicius Galba.
An alliance is agreed between Lucius Clodius Macer and you.
Quintus Annius Varus, legate of III Gallica, claims the purple in Moesia.
On the Rhine, the legions refuse their oath and hail Aulus Vitellius emperor.
Marcus Salvius Otho, once Nero's friend, buys the Praetorians and claims the throne.
A truce is agreed between Quintus Annius Varus and Quintus Numisius Marcellus.
A truce is agreed between Marcus Salvius Otho and Quintus Numisius Marcellus.
On the eve of battle, IV Macedonica goes over to Aulus Vitellius.
A truce is agreed between Aulus Vitellius and you.
The Senate votes you proconsular imperium: your command is now lawful in their eyes.
The Roxolani cross the frozen Danube into Moesia.
Lucius Didius Celer, legate of XII Fulminata, claims the purple in Syria.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Marcus Salvius Otho.
A trade agreement is made between Quintus Numisius Marcellus and Quintus Annius Varus. Merchants cross the lines.
A truce is agreed between Quintus Numisius Marcellus and Lucius Clodius Macer.
A trade agreement is made between Quintus Numisius Marcellus and Marcus Salvius Otho. Merchants cross the lines.
A truce is agreed between Marcus Salvius Otho and Aulus Vitellius.
In Britain, Venutius leads the Brigantes in revolt.
Aulus Licinius Rufus, legate of XX Valeria Victrix, claims the purple in Britannia.
Vologases sends envoys and gifts to Lucius Didius Celer: friendship, and the caravans of the East.
An alliance is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Aulus Licinius Rufus.
Aulus Fabius Pollio swears to you. He can command an army or govern a province for you.
A truce is agreed between Marcus Salvius Otho and you.
At Alexandria, the legions of the East hail Titus Flavius Vespasianus emperor. The last act begins.
Road repairs finished in Achaea.
Vologases sends envoys and gifts to Titus Flavius Vespasianus: friendship, and the caravans of the East.
Thracia: your men are beaten against III Gallica.
Thracia: your men are beaten against the garrison.
Thracia: your men are beaten against a walled town.
On the Rhine, the Batavian prince Julius Civilis stirs his people.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Gallia Aquitania.
Road repairs finished in Macedonia.
V Alaudae joins the army at Germania Superior.
XV Primigenia joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Germania Inferior joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Gallia Belgica joins the army at Germania Superior.
XI Claudia joins the army at Raetia.
On the eve of battle, The Praetorian Guard goes over to Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
Battle near Ephesus: Titus Flavius Vespasianus wins against Marcus Salvius Otho.
An alliance is agreed between Titus Flavius Vespasianus and Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Agrippa II sends 3000 men to Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
Battle near Roma: night falls with neither army broken. Aulus Vitellius draws off.
On the eve of battle, I Adiutrix goes over to Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
Battle near Corinth: Titus Flavius Vespasianus wins against Marcus Salvius Otho.
II Augusta joins the army at Germania Superior.
IX Hispana joins the army at Germania Superior.
XX Valeria Victrix joins the army at Germania Superior.
In the camp: your men win against raiders.
Antiochus IV of Commagene sends 4000 men to Aulus Vitellius.
A truce is agreed between Servius Sulpicius Galba and you.
The frontier breaks in Pannonia. Raiders burn the farms; no taxes will come from there for months.
Battle near Roma: night falls with neither army broken. Aulus Vitellius draws off.
On the eve of battle, New legion of Campania and the south goes over to Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
Marcus Salvius Otho falls back from Campania and the south rather than fight Titus Flavius Vespasianus.
New legion of Gallia Belgica joins the army at Germania Superior.
The Garamantes raid the coast of Africa.
Gallia Lugdunensis: your men are beaten against a walled town.
Gallia Lugdunensis: your men are beaten against a walled town.
The Senate recognises Titus Flavius Vespasianus as emperor.
Battle near Roma: night falls with neither army broken. Aulus Vitellius draws off.

storyLog.title: An accuser in the Senate
storyLog.text: He is acquitted. The accuser will look for an easier victim.

storyLog.title: Pirates
storyLog.text: Your liburnians clear the sea lanes.

storyLog.title: Deserters
storyLog.text: They take the oath again, to you this time.

storyLog.title: An informer
storyLog.text: Whether he was guilty, nobody now will know.

storyLog.title: The Arval Brothers
storyLog.text: Your name is cut into the bronze of the acts of the Brothers.

storyLog.title: A legate offers his sword
storyLog.text: He swears by Jupiter and by your genius.

storyLog.title: The veterans
storyLog.text: A new colony of old soldiers. The locals are not asked.

storyLog.title: The centurions come
storyLog.text: They will remember the promise, and the day it falls due.

storyLog.title: The merchants' petition
storyLog.choice: Halve the tolls for six months
storyLog.text: More ships put in at your harbours.
